title: Someone Will Be Disappointed
seoTitle: Someone Will Be Disappointed | Faraz Ansari
description: A personal essay on expectations, family, freedom and responsibility: can we live with disappointing people without abandoning care and fairness?
deck: On the freedom to choose, the expectations we inherit, and why doing the right thing does not always make everyone happy.
heroAlt: A lone illustrated figure standing at diverging paths beneath a balancing line, representing expectations and the freedom to choose.
heroCaption: Choosing a path while accepting that not everyone will agree with it.

sources.name: Faiz Ahmad Faiz — Bol (nazm)
sources.context: Verified Urdu line and poetry attribution; the nazm addresses speaking out against repression.

sources.name: Qur'an, Surah An-Nisa 4:135
sources.context: The verse concerns standing for justice and truthful witness, including when doing so is against one's own interests or family.
